topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session's learning outcomes and frames the discussion around the hallmarks of cancer and loss of growth control.

topics.label: Sustaining Proliferative Signaling and Resisting Growth Inhibition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how mutations in signaling cascades, including Wnt/beta-catenin, receptor tyrosine kinases, and TGF-beta pathways, deregulate cellular growth and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Hematological and Epithelial Cancers
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how impaired terminal differentiation maintains cells in proliferative states across leukemias and intestinal carcinomas.

topics.label: Resistance to Apoptotic Cell Death
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the molecular mechanisms regulating apoptotic resistance, focusing on p53, Bax, and BCL2 interactions at the mitochondrial membrane.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality, Telomeres, and Cellular Senescence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the mechanisms governing the Hayflick limit, telomerase activation, and how p53 mediates stress-induced senescence and genome integrity.

topics.label: Reprogramming Energy Metabolism in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain cancer metabolic alterations, including aerobic glycolysis, metabolic rewiring across tumor types, and the epigenetic consequences of oncometabolites.

topics.label: Inducing Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the necessity of new blood vessel formation for tumor growth and the balance between pro- and anti-angiogenic signals.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Dynamics of Cancer Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the metastatic cascade, seed-and-soil interactions, diagnostic tracking of dissemination, and the genomic features underlying metastatic clones.

topics.label: Conclusion and Final Summary
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session with final remarks on hallmark complexity, revisits the learning outcomes, and invites questions.
